residual_risks: Realtime fan-out remains process-local in memory, so multi-instance delivery is still a documented runtime limitation outside this task's scope.

The post-fix regression tests pass for unread recount failure handling and websocket/REST message-length parity, but deployed reconnect behavior is still best validated with one live browser sanity check.
Removing SSE and polling should reduce duplicate long-lived transport cost, but actual Cloud Run savings still need the post-deploy measurement already documented in the task handoff.
